page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation without hyperthreading ensures predictable, non-shared compute resources, which represents a high-density compute profile suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance.

Given the balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU cores, this instance is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, medium-sized databases, and continuous integration pipelines that demand stable processing power without resource contention.
